review.notes: Gate FAIL (set_option x10, sorry-data x4 plus 2 in SurfaceInvariants.lean, 11 Mathlib submodule imports and no import Mathlib, roadmap-module import, 18 blob links, 2 tex, depcheck 3 UPWARD; build OK). FuchsianOrbifolds is on main with Layers 0,1,3 built in Tau Ceti; the PR extends it in place by Layers 4a/7/8/9 (950 new lines) whose suppliers are open PRs, and TeichmullerGeometry (#1169, in the order) consumes its Layers 0-8 while Layer 9 consumes TeichmullerGeometry: a roadmap-level cycle. Rejected because no edit inside the folder repairs that; the extension must be a new roadmap folder. Suggested.lean re-declares with sorry what the pinned Tau Ceti has (PSL action, CuspDatum, CompactifiedQuotient and its manifold instance, TriangleOrder, IsCofinite, jBiholomorph) and states no headline; two statable headlines (cofinite => compact, pi/21 minimum) absent. Elaborated Suggested.lean (21 sorry warnings, nothing else), a #check file of all declarations and the pinned names, and a one-tactic probe (two theorems close). Sample verified: Odlyzko 1977 Theorem 1 with f1/f2, estimates (4)/(5), Table 1 rows (J-STAGE scan, pages read as images), Odlyzko Tables 2/4 (31 rows), Takeuchi 1983 Thm 2.1 and 1975 Thms 1-2, BGLS sections, Bader-Furman Def 2.3/Thm 2.5/Lemma 2.6/Thm 3.2/Lemma 4.2 (arXiv v1). Adversarial table: Layer 4a minima, covolume formula at k=Q, Tamagawa chain, Gram determinants, local volumes, trace identities, Odlyzko constants and the n=9 ratio 1.203691, the order-32 Gassmann pair (classes, intersections, nonconjugacy, generation, characters), genus 8g-7. Not verifiable: Voight (paywalled), the textbook spines, Maclachlan-Reid, Margulis.
